study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized resting-state functional connectivity abnormalities unveil two major depressive disorder subtypes with contrasting abnormal patterns of abnormality

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: REST-meta-MDD consortium data (25 research sites) was the primary dataset for MDD analysis; COBRE (Center for Biomedical Research Excellence) was used for disease specificity analysis comparing schizophrenia patients
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The imaging datasets for MDD used in this study were sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/RESTmeta-MDD)" ... "Finally, to examined whether extreme functional connectivity profile we reported is specific to MDD, we applied the same analysis pipeline to a dataset of schizophrenia patients from Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE, http://fcon_1000.-projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/cobre.html)"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Fang2025.pdf.md: MATERIALS AND METHODS / Imaging dataset and preprocessing, L37; Reproducibility and disease specificity analysis, L98

answer.REST-meta-MDD: normative reference construction (tolerance intervals from HCs) and clinical application (MDD patient subtyping)

answer.COBRE: disease specificity validation (schizophrenia vs MDD comparison)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: REST-meta-MDD HCs (n=1104) were used to construct tolerance intervals as normative reference; MDD patients (n=1276) were evaluated against this reference to identify extreme functional connections and identify subtypes. COBRE dataset (72 schizophrenia patients, 74 HCs) was used to validate that the extreme functional connectivity profile is specific to MDD
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we used the 'tolerance' package in R... to estimate nonparametric two-sided tolerance intervals for each functional connection in HCs" ... "Functional connections in individual subjects (both MDD and HCs) fell outside this range were classified as extreme" ... "we applied the same analysis pipeline to a dataset of schizophrenia patients from Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE)" ... "The COBRE dataset includes 72 schizophrenia patients and matched 74 HCs"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Fang2025.pdf.md: Identifying extreme functional connections in MDD, L73-74; Reproducibility and disease specificity analysis, L98

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study used 1104 healthy controls from REST-meta-MDD to construct tolerance intervals. No explicit train/test split was reported for the normative reference construction; all HCs appear to be used for tolerance interval estimation
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "These data include rsfMRI data from 25 research sites, comprising 1276 MDD patients (mean age: 36.23 ± 21.38 years, 63.71% females) and 1104 HCs (mean age: 36.15 ± 24.55 years, 58.06% females)"
